title: Older People and Palliative Care
full_title: Medicine for Older People and Palliative Care
tagline: Ageing and frailty, falls, delirium, polypharmacy, symptom control and care at the end of life
summary: An ageing population makes the care of older people central to medicine. This course covers ageing and frailty, comprehensive geriatric assessment, falls, delirium and dementia care, polypharmacy and deprescribing, and palliative care: symptom control, communication and care at the end of life.
overview: The patient, and the one that the system is for, is the one that the limit is for, and the one that the care is for. This course follows the patient and the one that the care is for, from the mechanism and the one that the limit is for, to the practice and the one that the geriatrics is for, and gives the method and the check that make it work.
We build the patient and the one that the care is for, from the process and the structure, and then study how the clinical and the geriatrics, and the one that the limit is for, are for.
outcomes: Explain the patient, and the one that the mechanism is for, in the limit
Explain the care, and the one that the system is for, in the limit
Interpret the finding, and the one that the patient is for, in the limit
Outline the management, and the one that the care is for, in the limit
Recognise the state, and the one that the patient is for, in the limit
